subject: health
unitTitle: Fueling, Movement, Sleep, and Recovery Without Diet Culture
title: Correction and reflection: body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging
focus: body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging
essentialQuestion: How do I keep my body supplied for school, work, and activity across a real week?
keyPoints: Body respect separates dignity and care from appearance; health messages that shame, promise rapid transformation, or use edited ideals are poor guides to wellbeing.
Compare care options by function, access, safety, and sustainability; avoid appearance rules, shame, rigid perfection, or assumptions about another person’s habits.

For body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Evaluate three fictional wellness plans for adequacy, safety, evidence, flexibility, and cost, then revise the weakest one. No calorie counts, weights, body-size targets, diet rules, or good/bad food labels are used or produced.
studentTask: Use the supplied fictional day to create a care plan for body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging. Identify two needs or barriers, choose two feasible supports, and explain how each supports function or recovery without appearance rules, shame, or a requirement to reveal personal habits.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging task using the supplied fictional or public case.
The response uses at least two accurate details from the lesson instruction and distinguishes evidence from assumption.
The response gives a safe, feasible next step or support route and does not depend on private disclosure, body comparison, or recorded media proof.
adaptationChoices: Evaluation may be written, spoken, chart-based, or completed against a supplied criteria checklist. extensionChallenge: Apply body respect and resisting appearance-based health messaging under a new constraint, compare two approaches, or explain the idea to someone else with an original fictional example, without completing another learner's graded work.
